items.title: Don Albert and Herbert Hall Interview, 1978-08-03
items.q: He said, well I'll tell you what I'm going to do. I'm going to bring you a stack of arrangements here tomorrow.

ctx.x: Because the band was formed so quickly. They had to have some music.

And there was a white band in Dallas Slain at the Adolphus Hotel. I can't remember the name of the screen so long ago. He said, well I'll tell you what I'm going to do. I'm going to bring you a stack of arrangements here tomorrow. And you can go ahead and arrest them. And the next day he brought them the whole trunk to all the arrangements.
